summary: migration silently skipped a newer user_version
observation: opening a PoC v4 DB succeeded; foreign keys from the new schema were absent
fix: throw when current > latest; document a new path

summary: metrics threw on an http event without status
observation: byStatus grouped NULL; the number schema rejected it
fix: filter status IS NOT NULL; count total separately

summary: a non-ISO injected clock committed then threw
observation: automation insert committed before the row parser rejected the timestamp
fix: validate the clock at open and on every tick

summary: setLastFiredAt wrote a value the reader rejected
observation: a minute string was stored; get then threw ValiError
fix: parse ISO before the UPDATE; store full ISO

summary: tests did not prove the version, token, and limit invariants
observation: reopen passed without user_version; token update and limits were untested
fix: assert user_version, token rotation, and 0/10000 limits

summary: the pinned run graph was write-only
observation: graph_json was stored but no repository method returned it
fix: add getRunGraph and test it after a workflow update

summary: new rows accepted timestamps core's schema rejects
observation: last_fired_at and firing.at were plain strings; core uses ISO
fix: use IsoTimestampSchema; full ISO for firing time

summary: LIKE wildcards were not escaped in title search
observation: q=% matched every conversation
fix: escape %, _ and backslash with ESCAPE; test the wildcards

summary: the default clock cached the open timestamp
observation: the first write after reopen used the open time
fix: cache the first tick only for an injected clock

summary: the ISO rule had two homes
observation: inline v.isoTimestamp remained next to the core codec
fix: import IsoTimestampSchema everywhere; scan ownership

summary: the core comment described a minute but the schema is ISO
observation: Automation.last_fired_at says minute; schema and store use ISO
fix: update the comment; port the scheduler to full ISO

summary: operationId could write outside the root
observation: a hostile operationId became a path segment
fix: generate the temp name internally; never splice operationId into a path

summary: watcher turned a directory creation into an unhandled rejection
observation: mkdir during watch produced an unhandled rejection
fix: ignore is_directory; emit overflow for unknown failures

summary: agent bash inherited the server environment
observation: server env leaked into the sandboxed shell
fix: clear env; restore only PATH/HOME/etc.; add hide for key dirs

summary: createNoExecEnv rejected instead of returning Result
observation: callers saw a rejected promise, not err(...)
fix: return err(new ExecutionError("shell_unavailable"))

summary: FileError was not mapped to FileFailure
observation: a directory read became a tool defect
fix: asFileFailure in one place; regression test

summary: query schema did not match wire strings
observation: "1" / "50" were rejected by number schemas
fix: parse query strings; add searchParamsObject

summary: journal save was not atomic or serialized
observation: concurrent writes could interleave the journal
fix: temp + flush + rename; chain saves

summary: a conflict outcome was not recorded
observation: retrying could apply a write after a conflict
fix: record conflict outcomes; replay returns them

summary: TOCTOU docs claimed more than the implementation
observation: the same-name swap window remained
fix: state the remaining window in docs

summary: a malformed direct operationId is not audited
observation: the pre-check throws Denied before #audit; docs say denials are audited
fix: audit with a null id or document the exception

summary: the ownership scan only sees literal redefinitions
observation: custom validators or new RegExp pass the scan; the README claim is stronger
fix: narrow the claim or assert a single export site

summary: the operationId alphabet is duplicated in the agent sanitizer
observation: the sanitizer repeats the alphabet and 64-char cap outside the codec
fix: add operationIdFrom(callId) to codecs.ts and use it

summary: the traversal-shaped operationId test was replaced by a benign id
observation: no test now sends ../../escape and checks no journal/temp appears
fix: use it in the rejection test and assert no journal op

summary: no test covers a non-ISO createFiring.at bypass
observation: runtime rejects before INSERT but the test suite does not prove it
fix: add the test beside setLastFiredAt

summary: @hns/server documents a bin entry that package.json does not declare
observation: the public surface section says `.` and bin (hns), but packages/server/package.json has no bin field
fix: drop the bin claim until the CLI lands, or add the entry in its issue

summary: the bearer-token regression comment also claims query-token coverage
observation: the test sends only Authorization: Bearer; no ?token= request is asserted although the comment names both
fix: assert the query token too or narrow the comment to the bearer token

summary: the request-id rejection test covers only a space-containing value
observation: the issue requires newline, control, and overlong rejection; only 'bad id' is exercised
fix: add a 129-character value and a control character to the rejection test

summary: the 101 response path has no test
observation: withResponseRequestId skips 101 and relies on the forwarded request header, but neither path is pinned by a test
fix: pin the 101 skip and forwarded header when the WebSocket face lands
